tertiary.name: Minor easy scroll case
notes: Players will always receive a minor easy scroll case on their 100th completed easy clue scroll ''or'' their first completed easy clue scroll if their clue count is above 100 (if the player has lost the item and did not open it before).

tertiary.name: Major easy scroll case
notes: Players will always receive a major easy scroll case on their 200th completed easy clue scroll ''or'' their first completed easy clue scroll if their clue count is above 200 (if the player has lost the item and did not open it before).

tertiary.name: Clue scroll (master)
notes: Clue scrolls will drop as scroll boxes after the completion of X Marks the Spot.

tertiary.name: Large spade
notes: Players will always receive a large spade on their 500th completed easy clue ''or'' their first completed easy clue afterwards if their clue count is above 500 (if the player has lost the item).

tertiary.name: Minor medium scroll case
notes: Players will always receive a minor medium scroll case on their 100th completed medium clue scroll ''or'' their first completed medium clue scroll if their clue count is above 100 (if the player has lost the item and did not open it before).

tertiary.name: Major medium scroll case
notes: Players will always receive a major medium scroll case on their 250th completed medium clue scroll ''or'' their first completed medium clue scroll if their clue count is above 250 (if the player has lost the item and did not open it before).

tertiary.name: Clueless scroll
notes: Players will always receive a clueless scroll on their 400th completed medium clue ''or'' their first completed medium clue afterwards if their clue count is above 400 (if the player has lost the item).
Players will always receive Super attack(4) together with Super strength(4) and Super defence(4).
